recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片低倍下，大量小至中型、核圓且染色質緻密、細胞質稀少嗜鹼性的淋巴球取代造血細胞；此倍率看不清細胞質突起或核仁，T-PLL 需依靠流式與 TCL1 檢測確認。
features: Hypercellular aspirate dominated by small to medium lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin
Scant, basophilic cytoplasm in many cells
Reduced residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors
Low magnification limits assessment of nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low magnification shows a cellular specimen extensively infiltrated by small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm, with reduced residual hematopoiesis. Fine cytologic details such as nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs are not resolvable at this power. Findings indicate marrow infiltration by a mature lymphoproliferative neoplasm and are consistent with T-prolymphocytic leukemia in the appropriate immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are CD5+/CD23+ B cells with soccer-ball chromatin, whereas T-PLL is a CD7-bright T-cell neoplasm with TCL1 overexpression.
Lymphoblasts have fine immature chromatin and are TdT/CD34 positive.
ATLL cells show polylobated nuclei and HTLV-1 positivity with CD25 expression.
